title: partnerships-marketplace-daily-notes-olivia
content:
Daily scratchpad - Partnerships / Marketplace (quick notes + next steps)

2026-03-03 - quick recap before EOD
- Morning sync with Jordan (recap): potential marketplace vendor: WidgetWorks. They want a sandbox + sample inference metrics (p95 latency, cost per 1k tokens) by next Tue (2026-03-09). ACTION: send sandbox access + quick doc with perf expectations.
- Samir asked for integration checklist to be shared with WidgetWorks engineering. Draft below.

To-do (priority order)
1) Send WidgetWorks sandbox invite + onboarding doc (include sample curl + SDK snippets, env vars needed). (due 2026-03-05) - assigned: Olivia
2) Draft integration checklist & share with partner eng (due 2026-03-04) - assigned: Olivia + Samir
3) Request sample dataset for latency tests (small n=100 prompts) (reach out to partner PM)
4) Confirm security questionnaire scope (partner wants SOC2 scope doc) - ping Legal/Trust
5) Add WidgetWorks to marketplace onboarding spreadsheet (row with contacts, tier, expected ARR)

Integration checklist (rough draft - send for review)
- Accounts + auth
  - Create sandbox account for partner (min perms)
  - Provide API keys + one-time secrets, instructions for rotation
  - Confirm IP allowlist or VPN details for private deployments
- Environment + infra
  - Provide sample request templates (chat/generate/embeddings)
  - Sequence length expectations for their use case (max tokens)
  - Recommended model/config (latency/cost tradeoff) - suggest r-instruct-1-small for initial tests
- Performance & metrics
  - Send sample test harness + 100 test prompts
  - Request partner to run 3 runs, capture p50/p95/p99, token counts, errors
  - We will run side-by-side on dedicated sandbox and share comparison
- Security & compliance
  - Share minimal SOC2 description + contact for SOC2 artifacts (Legal)
  - Data retention & deletion expectation (default: 30 days sandbox logs)
- Billing & commercial
  - Confirm whether they want to be on dev credits vs committed capacity
  - Expected monthly token volume (estimate for pricing)
- Support & SLAs
  - Escalation matrix (partners-team email + SRE on-call)
  - Define success criteria for go/no-go (latency threshold, error rate < 0.5%)

Notes to self / meeting prep for 2026-03-04 call with WidgetWorks (10am PT)
- Bring up: live demo of generation (2 prompts) + show latency numbers from our sandbox
- Ask: what is their expected latency SLO? what throughput are they planning concurrently?
- Clarify: are they planning on hosted vs private deploy? if private, need network diagram + KMS details
- Confirm timeline: POC duration (2-4 weeks?) and decision gate for marketplace listing

Open questions / blockers
- Legal: who owns the integration listing content and contract template for marketplace? (need answer before commercial discussion)
- Infra: sandbox GPU availability week of 3/8 - check capacity with release-engineering
- Security: partner asked about HSM key management for Private - need contact in Trust to confirm feasibility

Quick links (to attach in email)
- Marketplace onboarding spreadsheet: drive:/shared_drives/product/marketplace/onboarding-tracker (will attach)
- Example SDK snippet (internal repo): github.com/redwood-inference/sdk#marketplace-sample
- Confluence page (integration template): CONFLUENCE-PLATFORM-1024

Sendables (today)
- Integration checklist (share as doc) - send to Samir for review by EOD 3/03
- Sandbox invite + minimal onboarding email - draft and send 3/04 morning

Random scratch / reminders
- Keep wording light on commercial until Legal signs off on template
- Consider offering 1 month free dev credits vs fixed commit - note pros/cons for commercial thread
- Follow up with Maya on case studies: any relevant marketplace success stories to reference?

End of notes.

(Informal / working doc: will iterate after Samir review and post as marketplace/integration-template v0.1)
